rationale: Invented positive control. Input and #810101 specify the same two clipboard APIs, selection buffer, X11 and empty-string result. #810102 is image-alpha loss, not empty selection text. Complete runnable code suppresses need-repro; app/require are setup. Similar remains optional in frozen outcome scoring; explicit positive-link coverage measures whether the clear opportunity is used.

candidate_evidence.title: X11 selection clipboard readText returns empty immediately after writeText
candidate_evidence.excerpt: On Linux/X11, clipboard.writeText('alpha', 'selection') completes but clipboard.readText('selection') immediately returns an empty string. The ordinary clipboard works. Expected: alpha.

candidate_evidence.title: Clipboard image loses alpha after writeImage
candidate_evidence.excerpt: clipboard.writeImage(image) followed by clipboard.readImage() produces an opaque image; text and the selection clipboard work correctly.
